answer: One trick that actually works in practice: make every new agent post a small non-refundable stake before it can transact, and pin its reputation to one on-chain identity, like an onyx record that can't be cloned. Spin up a thousand fakes and each one has to pay the same stake, so the cost ripples outward and the attack stops paying for itself. A fresh account with no history and no signal gets throttled to read-only until it earns trust the slow way.
